This game is probably the most satisfying roguelike I have ever played! You only get one life per run, and the goal is to collect as many powerful items as fast as possible so that you can kill the monsters that are trying to kill you. The difficulty increases over time, but so does your power. If you can make it to the end game then you will simply destroy everything that spawns  because you'll be so powerful.

The part where this game shines the most is in the interaction of the items. With different combinations of items you can become incredibly powerful, and you have to adjust your play style each run to work with the items you get.

10/10 would buy the Hopoo Feather again.
A great, unique rogue-like game to kill time while you race against time. Many unique classes, monsters, items and maps. No other game like it.

This game is NOT fun. its supposed to be difficult, I know, but this is insane. The levels aren't balanced, co-op couln't be worse, and Don't even get me started on the items.
levels- The levels will apparently, change difficluty at random. So just when you think you got the hang of things, BANG. Super powered minion comes out of nowhere and kills you.
co-op- ugh, the co-op. where to start, first of all, you have to stay in the same area, or its pretty much garunteed death. Unlike oher games that won't let you leave the screen, in risk of rain you can fall of a ledge and see nothing but an arrow indicating where you are...at least until you get killed by a monster YOU CAN'T SEE. in additon, I was disconnected several times... IN FLIPPING LOCAL CO-OP!!! HOW DOES THAT EVEN HAPPEN?!?!? 
and Items- The game dosent give you any info on items. at all. You have to figure it out yourself. Was that random blue light just part of the background or was it a buff? which powerup did that explsion come from? I'LL NEVER KNOW!
unlocks-...HOW? I've played for half an hour with no unlocks, or indication of how to unlock things.
you know what? I'm done. I'm refunding this right now. It makes me angry to just think about it.

Very fun game. there is a lot to do in the game.
